postpaidPLUS 38 and postpaidPLUS 48

FAQ

New postpaidPLUS

  1. What is this new Postpaid plan?
    The new postpaidPLUS plan comes with a high-speed 5G data quota every month! No need to worry about extra charges if you use up your data—your data speed will simply be reduced to 64kbps until the next cycle.

  2. How long is this offer for?
    This is an offer effective from 03 August 2026.

  3. Where can I sign up for these plans?
    Feel free to visit any redONE Mobile stores or partners. Alternatively, you can conveniently register online whenever it suits you.

  4. Who is eligible to subscribe to the new Postpaid plans?
    All Malaysians and foreigners above 18 years old can sign up for these plans. The plan is available for new registrations, mobile number portability (MNP) port-ins, and rate plan changes. (Excluding M2M).

  5. How much do I need to pay upon registration?
    Postpaid PlanpostpaidPLUS38postpaidPLUS48
    Advance PaymentRM38RM48
    Registration FeeRM10RM10

    The Advance payment for all Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Port-in request is waived. If you require a higher credit limit, deposit is required if your tenure with redONE Mobile is less than 6 months. If you are a foreigner, you have to pay a deposit equivalent of their respective monthly credit limit.

  6. What are the data allocation of the new Postpaid plans?
    These are our new Postpaid plans with high-speed data quota per month with no speed cap, as below:
    Postpaid PlanspostpaidPLUS38postpaidPLUS48
    Monthly FeeRM38RM48
    Data300GB500GB
    Voice CallUnlimited CallsUnlimited Calls
    Mobile Hotspot/ Shareable dataTo be drawn from Data bucketTo be drawn from Data bucket
  7. Can I port-in to the new Postpaid plan?
    Yes. You can port-in and subscribe to the new Postpaid plans provided you do not have any outstanding balance or under contract with your current mobile service provider.

  8. Will I be tied to a contract if I sign up for this plan?
    This plan is not contracted.

  9. After I take up one of these plans, am I allowed to upgrade my monthly data bundle?
    You can buy the one-off Data Top Up by dialing *123# or log on to 1App to purchase additional data.

  10. Can I use the bundled data to create a hotspot?
    Yes, you can.

  11. If I have not utilised all my base and hotspot data, can I bring over the unused quota to next month?
    Unfortunately, your Internet quota are only valid until the end of the month. Any unused data won’t carry over and will be forfeited.

  12. I am an existing 5G Postpaid10 customer. Can I upgrade my plan to the new postpaidPLUS38?
    Yes, you can! You can easily upgrade the plan yourself, or reach out to our friendly customer care team for assistance.

  13. Can I register for any supplementary lines with postpaidPLUS38?
    Yes, you can register up to 6 supplementary lines per master.

  14. I purchased the redVIDEO 1 time Add-on, which data will be utilized first?
    Below table are the data utilization priority:
    UtilizationData Usage
    postpaidPLUS38postpaidPLUS48
    1stPurchased redVIDEO, redSOCIAL, redSTUDY, redMUSICPurchased redVIDEO, redSOCIAL, redSTUDY, redMUSIC
    2nd300GB bundled Data500GB bundled Data
    3rdPurchased Data Top UpPurchased Data Top Up
    4thBasic Internet @64kbpsBasic Internet @64kbps


redCALL

  1. What is redCALL?
    redCALL is a new Value-Added Service (VAS) that enables high voice usage customers to make unlimited voice calls to all networks in Malaysia.

  2. Do I need to activate/ subscribe redCALL?
    No, the redCALL will be activated automatically once your postpaidPLUS38 or postpaidPLUS48 plan is successfully activated or successfully ported-in.

  3. I don’t want the redCALL service. Can I terminate it?
    No, you cannot terminate the redCALL service. It is bundled with the postpaidPLUS38 and postpaidPLUS48 plan for you to enjoy unlimited calls to all networks in Malaysia.

  4. Is the unlimited voice calls to all networks valid for calls made when I am roaming?
    The unlimited voice calls is valid for domestic calls in Malaysia only.

  5. Does the unlimited voice calls include calls to fixed lines e.g. 03 numbers?
    Yes. The unlimited voice calls include all domestic calls to mobile numbers and fixed line numbers in Malaysia. Calls to special numbers are excluded.

  6. Is there a Fair Usage Policy for the unlimited voice calls?
    Yes, Fair Usage Policy of 100 hours per month is applicable.

  7. What happens when I exceed the Fair Usage Policy for unlimited calls?
    You can continue to call other networks’ numbers at RM0.15 per minute for the remaining days of the calendar month.

  8. What is included in the unlimited calls with redCALL?
    The unlimited calls include:
    • Calls to all Malaysian mobile numbers (including redONE Postpaid & Prepaid).
    • Calls to all Malaysian fixed line numbers.

  9. What is NOT included in the unlimited calls?
    The following are excluded:
    • Calls to special numbers (1300, 1700, 1600, 1MOCC).
    • Calls to premium and special rate numbers.
    • Video calls.
    • International (IDD) calls.

  10. Are there any usage restrictions for the unlimited calls?
    Yes, the unlimited calls are for personal use only. They must not be used for:
    • Re-selling, renting, or commercial purposes.
    • Call rerouting devices, software, or auto diallers.
    • Call centres, telemarketing, or conference calling.
    • Continuous, automated, or machine to machine communication.

Fast Track Loyalty – Free Phone

What happens to the contract if I take up this offer?

24 months for powerGADGET68, or
36 months for powerGADGET98.

Eligibility criteria:
Minimum 6 months on current plan (180 days from sign-up or successful MNP).
No barring or suspension in the past 3 months; all master and sub-lines must be active.
Master line must not be under contract.
No active contracted device bundles under any Loyalty Project.
No outstanding payments across all accounts linked to the same NRIC.
Only successfully activated lines are eligible to receive the free smartphone.
